_source.note: Regional GitHub Pages sites (and, once one exists, a Cloudflare R2 bucket) that host county data files. GitHub Pages publishes at most 1 GB per site. Cloudflare's R2 pricing page (developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing, read 19 Nov 2026): free tier 'Storage | 10 GB-month / month' and 'There are no charges for egress bandwidth'. A remote source is used only when enabled, after its site was checked to serve a county file with access-control-allow-origin: *; otherwise the page loads the file from this site's counties/ folder.

r2.note: Cloudflare R2 bucket city-pretty-data, public r2.dev address (no custom domain yet). Checked 19 Nov 2026: 1,385 county files uploaded with scripts/r2_sync_counties.py (1.138 GB stored); counties/bundle_48453, bundle_17031, bundle_47135 and bundle_06075 were fetched from this address with an Origin header and returned 200 with access-control-allow-origin: * and an ETag, byte-identical to the repository copies for the first three. HARD LIMIT set by the owner: R2 storage must never exceed the 10 GB free allowance; upload only with scripts/r2_sync_counties.py, which stops at 8 GB. See CLAUDE.md.
